input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Candidate, Content Creator roles. It exposes interfaces for managing book. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with book functionality, so that I can accomplish my book-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Content Creator, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Candidate, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Content Creator, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
